Page one is bulk lists of 45-150 wishes (swifdoo, latintimes, American Greetings); this post wins on timing (Eve, morning, his family's meal, first Christmas, long distance), and the refreshed card is accurate.

reviews.summary: The reordered card reads as honest, not like an ad; the moment-by-moment lines (the tree on the bus, blink twice) are ones to screenshot. Polish only, as before, on the hidden-message-link sentence.

Round one's fix made exactly, in both languages: three short sentences, no single-currency price. Better than the top results because the messages are tied to when he reads them; the Spanish is localised (polvorones, a las cinco de la tarde).
The keyword and a long-distance variant still return undifferentiated lists; none organises by moment of the day or covers his family's meal and the time difference, which this post does.
